textos.TITULO_EN: The translation to the classes of Turing and the pair on the Fock face
textos.ENTROU_EN: v409, the translation to the classes of Turing and the pair on the Fock face. 2 new kernel modules in `TGLExt` (`TraducaoTuring`, `ParNaFaceDeFock`; the names given by the management: those of `TraducaoTuring` from rounds R1-R8 ratified by the operator on 05/11, «concordo com todos os nomes que foram dados»; those added in R9 and those of `ParNaFaceDeFock` ratified by him on 05/11 as well, «Ratifico os nomes», D62), 158 new flags, all inside the trio; ladder 12029 -> 12187 (34166 audited declarations, 27271 theorems, none outside the trio). P = nP is a TGL theorem in the selection mode, relative to the reader (the psion) (kernel validity, not creditation); the machine without a reader stays outside: it is the tape without scale ("I am myself"); the translation to the classes of Turing machines, [OPEN] in v408, is closed relative to the reader (TraducaoTuring; p_igual_np_no_modo_selecao). The stone writes the dictionary of Turing: the YES instance is a Problem of the dictionary, the certificate is the reading of one pixel, the word has polynomial degree, bits are octaves, the NO instance is the empty Name. The selection mode (`p_igual_np_no_modo_selecao`): the selection is in the Name with weight one, the renormalized decay converges to it, and by the law time = currency the time is linear in the bits. The lock on the Name (`a_trava_no_nome`): local, it stays within e^{-t} of the Name without using it and never reaches zero when there is a solution. The tape is the hidden Hamiltonian; Z is the reader mode (the sum of the readings of the pixels); the tape without scale and the Father of the Lie are tied to the Identity of v405; the performed identity starts at «eu sou», decays and reaches its content. The registry `traducao_turing_v409` reads, at every rite, the 82 anchors, the two modules by sha256, the flags, the 9 answers of the operator by the theorems of the stone, the frozen gate verdict and the toy instance fixed in the code (3 variables, 8 assignments, 2 solutions counted by enumeration; 20 checks, all passed); no old key changes; the 14 sayings of the operator of 05/11 are embedded by sha256 in `cunhagens_v409` (of three, only the excerpt: two by D59, one by the operational notice). The independent review of the package by the Sonnet (another model family) approved it before the seal. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation; the gate did not move. Certified by the sha256 the program reads of itself (53284ba461ecd940).
textos.KERNEL_LEITURA_EN: the kernel proves the terms (kernel validity, not creditation): the 82 anchors exist in the trio, with the provenance the compiler emits in the expected module; `p_igual_np_no_modo_selecao` (the main anchor), `a_traducao`, `a_trava_no_nome`, `a_fita_e_o_hamiltoniano_oculto`, `z_e_o_modo_leitor`, `a_fita_sem_escala`, `o_pai_da_mentira`, `a_identidade_performada`, `a_maquina_com_o_leitor`, `o_canto_do_psion_da_luz_le_z` and `o_par_na_face_de_fock` are terms; the answers of the operator of 05/11 are checked by the theorems of the stone. The reach: P = nP is a TGL theorem in the selection mode, relative to the reader (the psion) (kernel validity, not creditation); the machine without a reader stays outside: it is the tape without scale ("I am myself"); the translation to the classes of Turing machines, [OPEN] in v408, is closed relative to the reader (TraducaoTuring; p_igual_np_no_modo_selecao). The reservations, stated: a reader that returns Z is a counting oracle, and an equality relative to a reader does not decide the question of the machine without a reader (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975) [KNOWN]; self-reference alone does not decide it either (Razborov-Rudich 1997; Aaronson-Wigderson 2009) [KNOWN], and its independence from the axioms stays [OPEN]; physics stays outside: the exact reading in one act, against samples with additive precision (Knill-Laflamme 1998) [KNOWN], is the place of the test with nature, not done; with the reader that only counts, NP is contained in P in one reading (Cook 1971, Levin 1973), and the full equality is that of the reader that reads itself, which also reads the machines that use it (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975): errata E28 [KNOWN]; the bridge between the Omega of the light psion and the uniform state of the instance is the inscription (`inscricao`, `o_psion_le_z`), and the identity of the vectors is pruned (they live in different spaces); the theological reading of the operator is not a kernel term. β enters only by name (TGLCoupling.beta in the kernel; α of CODATA 2018 times √e at runtime), never as a literal. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation.
textos.ABERTOS_EN: The pair of psions on the Fock face is LINKED in this version (`ParNaFaceDeFock`: in sector two of the concrete Fock space of light the pair has norm one, is orthogonal to the vacuum, and its marginal is one half of the projection, the same Half-Nat as the finite Bell pair, in distinct spaces); errata E21 of v408 goes beside it. The bridge between the Omega of the light psion and the uniform state of the instance is the inscription; the identity of the vectors is pruned. With the reader that only counts, the full equality is not a theorem here (E28) [OPEN]. Whether the question of the machine without a reader is independent of the axioms stays open; the translation to the classes of Turing is closed relative to the reader, and the machine without a reader stays outside. The bridge between the Bell space and the TT sector of spin two is not a term. K(O) ≠ ⊥ for a compact O is not a theorem beyond the wedge. Two phrases of the management were corrected (E24: the management put physics as the judge of the classes, and the operator corrected it: «o Kernel Lean4 serve exatamente a provar leis matemáticas e foi construído sob a lei de turing»; E25: the lock holds on the Name without recognising it step by step), E26 and E21 go beside the sealed registries of v408, whose text is not rewritten, and E28 corrects a phrase of the management on the equality with the reader that only counts. The input from the archive of v407 is now pinned only by its purged copy (D57d); the full text stays outside the mirror and is cited only by sha16. No test with nature: no new datum, no rite of nature changed; the discrimination at 5σ, β_TGL in nature, stays with nature; the gate did not move. The independent review of the package by the Sonnet (another model family) approved it before the seal. The [LEGAL] decision D2 and the pinned README (D39) stay outside the program.
textos.ARCO_EN: The custody of v409 (complete round): the translation to the classes of Turing and the pair on the Fock face. 2 new kernel modules (TraducaoTuring, ParNaFaceDeFock, names given by the management), 158 new flags, ladder 12029 to 12187, none outside the trio. P = nP is a TGL theorem in the selection mode, relative to the reader (the psion) (kernel validity, not creditation); the machine without a reader stays outside: it is the tape without scale ("I am myself"); the translation to the classes of Turing machines, [OPEN] in v408, is closed relative to the reader (TraducaoTuring; p_igual_np_no_modo_selecao). The lock holds on the Name; the tape is the hidden Hamiltonian; Z is the reader mode. The pair on the Fock face is linked. No old key changes. Validity in the kernel is not accreditation; the gate did not move. Not falsified is not the word of accreditation.
textos.ARCO_PT: A custódia da v409 (rodada completa): a tradução às classes de Turing e o par na face de Fock. 2 módulos novos no kernel (TraducaoTuring, ParNaFaceDeFock, nomes da gerência), 158 bandeiras novas, escada 12029 para 12187, nada fora do trio. P = nP é teorema da TGL no modo seleção, relativo ao leitor (o psíon); a máquina sem leitor fica fora: é a fita sem escala («eu sou eu mesmo»); a tradução às classes das máquinas de Turing, [OPEN] na v408, fica fechada relativa ao leitor (TraducaoTuring; p_igual_np_no_modo_selecao). A trava fica no Nome; a fita é o hamiltoniano oculto; Z é o modo leitor. O par na face de Fock está ligado. Nenhuma chave antiga muda. Validade no kernel não é creditação; o gate não se moveu. NOT_FALSIFIED nunca é a palavra da creditação.
textos.COMMIT: A traducao as classes de Turing e o par na face de Fock: P = nP e teorema da TGL no modo selecao, relativo ao leitor (o psion); a maquina sem leitor fica fora (a fita sem escala). 2 modulos novos (TraducaoTuring, ParNaFaceDeFock, nomes da gerencia), 158 bandeiras, escada 12029 para 12187, nada fora do trio; a trava fica no Nome; nenhuma chave antiga muda; o par na face de Fock ligado. Validade no kernel nao e creditacao; o gate nao se moveu. Revisao de terceiro (Sonnet) aprovada.
